decisions.why: Preserve pre-existing ignore rule while adding the specified patterns

decisions.what: Added @typescript-eslint/parser, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, eslint-plugin-security and globals to root devDependencies, plus a 'prepare: husky' script
decisions.why: eslint.config.js imports these packages and husky hooks need installing; without them lint and the pre-commit hook would fail

decisions.what: Implemented no-unused-vars via @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars with args 'after-used' and disabled the base rule
decisions.why: Base rule produces false positives on TypeScript types

decisions.what: Applied 'concurrent: false' as '--concurrent false' in the husky pre-commit lint-staged call
decisions.why: lint-staged config files do not support a concurrent option; it is a CLI flag
Required for 'tsc' type-checking of React TypeScript code
